author: kevaundray
content: A fresh writeup would be great please!

author: potuz
content: Hello, this may be controversial but given that broadcast is the bottleneck and that data directly competes with this broadcast of aggregates at the same time I want to propose a substantial increase in a minimum blob gas price for Hegota

author: barnabasbusa
content: can we even do blobs pq?

author: vladimir_ea
content: Currently, in Fulu, data columns typically arrive before the block and before individual attestations. In Gloas, they can be released as soon as the bid is seen, there is no reason to delay release as there is for the execution payload. Seems they are more likely to propagate before aggrgates?

author: vladimir_ea
content: I understand the deadline is later, but they can be sent any time after the bid I think

author: potuz
content: we will most likely keep them on the first fork and make them PQ in the second, but regardless, any DA layer should pay much more IMO

author: potuz
content: yes, but the whole point of Gloas was to enable them to saturate the slot, if we are not going to use that then there is no point in setting the deadline later

author: potuz
content: At any rate, even if sent early, they will be competing with aggregates from the previous slot still being propagated and with single attestation also being much larger

author: potuz
content: It's a no brainer that we need to increase the blob price and substantially so IMO

author: potuz
content: bandwidth is our most precious commodity right now and we are giving it for free

author: barnabasbusa
content: always has been

author: vladimir_ea
content: and yet we go ahead with BALs and 200m gas? surely that should be reconsidered? is it on the agenda?

author: barnabasbusa
content: we generally allocate 6s for CL and 6s for EL

author: barnabasbusa
content: so I think its ok to have 200M gas with BALs if we can ship it in 6s

author: vladimir_ea
content: I mean these both dramatically increase the size of the execution payload re. bandwidth constraints

author: potuz
content: we timed it and benched it to be more than fine in Gloas. The deadline also makes it somewhat fine in PQ, but blobs are a different beast and they pay zero

author: vladimir_ea
content: I glad you feel confident about it. I just have a bad feeling that if bandwidth is the most precious commodity, then spending it on non-PQ things at this point will make PQ harder.

author: potuz
content: we can always lower the gas limit to limit the payload size, but we can't stop blob txs from entering the mempool and landing without a hard fork. I honestly think a minimum gas increase is beyond being a no-brainer, it's irresponsible not to do it

author: kevaundray
content: Even if we are confident, I think it does still make sense to benchmark and quantify what increasing the gas limit to 200M gas will have on the EL side when coupled with mempool/stark aggregation(~300KB) and the new EL signature scheme (~8KB)
